study type: Population-based cohort study and hospital-based retrospective cohort study
outcome: Fetal outcomes (growth restriction, fetal malformations, Apgar score)
cohort: 996 women with ankylosing spondylitis and 1:10 matched general population controls (population-based cohort); 21 women with ankylosing spondylitis and 1:4 matched controls (hospital-based cohort)
finding: Women with ankylosing spondylitis had higher rates of Caesarean section compared to controls, but other maternal and offspring complications were similar.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were higher in women with ankylosing spondylitis.
